territorial_scope.description: Issued by a federal regulator and applies to permit applications under the Mexican electric sector framework.

evidence.quote: Estados Unidos Mexicanos.- Comisión Nacional de Energía.

summary.short: Mexican energy regulator CNE agreement (dated 23 July 2025) setting the documents applicants must file to obtain a generation permit for interconnected self-supply plants of 0.7 to 20 MW. Applicants must submit the listed items to the CNE; the CNE will resolve requests under implementing regulations.
summary.long: The Agreement of the Comisión Nacional de Energía (CNE), dated 23 July 2025, sets the requirements for a generation permit for interconnected self-supply (autoconsumo interconectado) in power plants with capacity between 0.7 and 20 MW, following a simplified procedure referred to in the Electric Sector Law. Applicants must file with the CNE an authorised form and documents, including identification and legal capacity, technology and capacity, a georeferenced site proposal, a simplified single-line diagram, a simplified works schedule, a business plan if the plant is not yet installed, evidence of technical and financial capacity, a shareholding diagram where applicable, and proof of fee payment. Documents already held by the CNE or in the citizen digital file need not be resubmitted. The CNE must analyse and resolve requests under the regulation and administrative provisions to be issued. Transitional provisions make the Agreement effective when the implementing regulations of the Electric Sector and Energy Planning and Transition laws enter into force; the CNE must publish the form on its website and in the Diario Oficial de la Federación, review it annually, and register the procedure in the citizen portal. Permit holders must observe the contract models, calculation methodologies and criteria for consideration that the CNE issues. No penalties are set out in the text.

notes: The document shows no amendments or repeals. Entry into force (Transitorio Primero) depends on the entry into force of the regulations of the Ley del Sector Eléctrico and the Ley de Planeación y Transición Energética, not on a fixed date. The document is dated 23 July 2025; the DOF publication date 06-08-2025 in the registry metadata does not appear in the text. Considerandos cite LSE arts. 16-19 (permit from 0.7 MW) and art. 30 second paragraph (0.7-20 MW simplified route); no numerical conflict found. Procedure, contract models and user lists are deferred to regulations and CNE general provisions not in the document. Relations to the Ley Nacional para Eliminar Trámites Burocráticos include arts. 53 and 78 cited operatively, recorded in its legal_basis row. Target instrument IDs are blank because the registry IDs for these instruments were not provided.
